Paths: hpc/run_kleborate_expansion.sh
Summary: Fix kleborate version detection and re-enable stderr logging Use 2>/dev/null (not 2>&1) for --version so BioPython deprecation warnings don't pollute the version string and cause '3.11' (from the python3.11 path) to be parsed as version 3.
